HTML5 Website Design and Why It’s Worth to Hire HTML5 Developer

Let’s begin with the simple things. What is HTML 5 and who is an HTML5 developer? HTML5 is the latest version of HyperText Markup Language. It’s a new level of making websites’ structure. Along with CSS, JavaScript, and frontend user interface developer, an HTML5 developer can create amazing websites. If you don’t know to code, we are pretty sure that you haven’t heard the new things, that HTML5 developers can do with websites. The most awesome features an HTML5 developer can do are video and audio integration. Examples of video background, you can see at paypal, airbnb, and others. An HTML5 programmer can create websites with that power feature, but as for HTML5 developers, it isn’t the main one. According to the code.tutsplus.com, there are 28 HTML5 techniques, features and tips an HTML5 coder must know. Some of them are minor improvements, but others make a difference in the process of creating websites. But, for us, as users, the most important is high definition videos and extraordinary graphics, right? :)

Where to Look for HTML5 Development Company

It won’t be a secret, if we say that it is a person! Unexpectedly. Okay, talking seriously, it’s someone, who knows about web development a lot. Especially about latest trends and new features. Hire HTML5 developer to create website on HTML5. Because there is no “one-size-fits-all” solution to the market. According to venturebeat, 91% of respondents (of 3500 developers) said that they are already developing with HTML5, including many countries: USA, UK, Europe and evern software developer Philippines. In Brief, take a look at these new elements for better document structure, done by W3schools.

Okay, let’s roll to the main changes. Hire HTML5 developer and see two of them. And they are connected with a simplification of the HTML structure, so you could understand the point.

  1. New Doctype.

In example, now you need to type

<!DOCTYPE html>

and before you have to type this:

<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC “-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN”

and more. So, quite nice improvement.

  1. The Semantic Header and Footer. Before:
<div id=”header”>
…
</div>
<div id=”footer”>
…
</div>

New version:

<header>
…
</header>
<footer>
…
</footer>

Awesome, isn’t it?
